Build the full 990 organization-year panel

Source: R/matching.R
get_panel.Rd

Reads the header, summary, expenses, and balance-sheet tables for every 990 and 990-EZ filer in years (only the columns in panel_columns()), keeps one return per organization-year (org_years()), and returns the slim matching panel from panel_measures(). This is the pool that merger recipients are matched against.

Usage

get_panel(
  years = efile_years(),
  path = "PANEL990",
  source = panel990::data_source(),
  verbose = TRUE,
  bmf = TRUE,
  base_year = 2024L
)

Arguments

years

Tax years.

path, source, verbose

Passed to panel990::download_tables().

bmf

Add NTEE codes from the BMF (get_bmf()): TRUE, FALSE, or a BMF table you already have.

base_year

Year of the dollars in the REAL_* columns.

Value

A data.table keyed by EIN2, TAX_YEAR; see panel_measures().
